## Nucor Invites You to Join Its Second Quarter of 2026 Conference Call on the Web


07/14/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 151 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/531038915/files/doc_news/Nucor-Invites-You-to-Join-Its-Second-Quarter-of-2026-Conference-Call-on-the-Web-2026.pdf)


CHARLOTTE, N.C.


, July 14, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- In conjunction with Nucor's (NYSE: NUE) second quarter earnings release, you are invited to listen to its live conference call with host Leon Topalian, Nucor's Chair and Chief Executive Officer. This conference call will include a review of Nucor's results for the second quarter ended July 4, 2026, followed by a question-and-answer session. The event will be available on the internet on July 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


What:


Nucor's Second Quarter of 2026 Conference Call


When:


10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, July 28, 2026


Where:


[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/857142384](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4730281-1&h=4049393995&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F857142384&a=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F857142384) or at[https://nucor.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4730281-1&h=4285077542&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnucor.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fnucor.com%2F)


How:


Log on to the web at either of the addresses above


Archive:


If you are unable to participate during the live webcast, the archived call will
be available at[http://www.nucor.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4730281-1&h=184728410&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nucor.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nucor.com) .


Nucor and its affiliates are manufacturers of steel and steel products, with operating facilities in the United States, Canada and Mexico. Products produced include: carbon and alloy steel -- in bars, beams, sheet and plate; hollow structural section tubing; electrical conduit; steel racking; steel piling; steel joists and joist girders; steel deck; fabricated concrete reinforcing steel; cold finished steel; precision castings; steel fasteners; metal building systems; insulated metal panels; overhead doors; steel grating; wire and wire mesh; and utility structures. Nucor, through The David J. Joseph Company and its affiliates, also brokers ferrous and nonferrous metals, pig iron and hot briquetted iron / direct reduced iron; supplies ferro-alloys; and processes ferrous and nonferrous scrap. Nucor is North America's largest recycler.
